positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Implementing controllers and models in ASP.Net Core for micro-services in Azure Service Fabric cluster.
• Migrated code from a .NET Framework CLR mixed assemble to Pinvoke to enable cross platform functionality. 
• Responsible for reliability testing and testing infrastructure of production software
    - Wrote unit tests and functional/integration tests using MSTest and xUnit framework.
    - Deployed and managed Hyper-V VMs for testing
    - Debugging native (C++) and managed (C#) code from crash dumps and test failures
• Functioning as the security advocate for my development team.
    - Implemented security related processes and tools SonarQube, Appverifier, CPPCheck, and BinSkim.
    - Provide security related feedback in code reviews.
    - Created and maintained SDL threat model.
• Developed a custom Peach protocol in C# for fuzzing OSIsoft proprietary communication protocol. Involved understanding the Peach source code (in C#), reading Wireshark captures, and debugging with Visual Studio.
• Fuzzed OSIsoft proprietary communication protocol using the Peach fuzzing framework. Created new input files for fuzzing this protocol. Updated existing Peach input files from Peach 2 to 3.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
•	Provide frontline support for the OSISoft PI suite of products (400+ products), including: analytics, interfaces, data archive server, clients and data access.
•	Provide escalation (Tier 2) support for Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) interfaces to monitor various types of smart metering systems.
•	Troubleshoot and run root cause analyze of dataflow disruptions by examining logs, crash dumps and source code.
•	Diagnose and solve complex software and networking issues on Windows systems (Active Directory, DNS, and Kerberos).
•	Write and analyze scripts in VB.NET, Powershell, and C++ /C# to help customers solve difficult problems.
•	Recommend best practices for architecture and data integrity to prevent reoccurring problems.
•	Set up virtual environments for replicating customer’s problems and training other technical support engineers. 
•	Work in a team to develop a web application in PHP for internal review of technical support cases for QA.
•	Oversee, instruct and develop content for training new technical support engineers on general troubleshooting methodology and internal procedures.
•	Identify and manage various customer demands simultaneously. Promptly reply to customer requests and needs.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
•	National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship recipient
•	Conducted research on behaviors of structure during dynamic loading by couple computer simulation (FEA models) with physical experiments.
•	Developed software in C++ for performing structural simulation that used advanced control system methods.
•	Completed course work in database, software engineer and parallel computing.
•	Developed advanced control models in Mathworks Simulink to run PID controllers and hydraulic actuators.
•	Taught workshops on how run computation simulation and the software we developed in our research group.
•	Teaching Assistant for Finite Element Course and Instructor for structural simulation workshops.

positions.title: Structural Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed steel structures including facades, various bracing systems and connections.
•	Proficient in building codes – IBC, UBC, ASCE 7, AISC ASD and SBC.

positions.title: Civil Engineering Officer
positions.description:
•	U.S. Air Force Commendation Medals with one Oak Leaf Cluster

Project Manager, Little Rock Air Force Base, Arkansas	2/2000 – 6/2004
•	Prepared plans, specifications, cost estimates, and engineering analysis for base construction projects and negotiated modifications.

Chief of Engineering Operations, Seeb North Air Base, Sultanate of Oman	9/2002 - 12/2002	
•	Deployed to Seeb North Air Base in support of Operation Enduring Freedom.
•	Led a team of over 40 Air Force members who were responsible for the maintenance, construction, and defense of Seeb North Air Base.
